_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.

# SmartCuff NI acquisition delivery update

Default v3.1.339 / followup-313 and Valinor v3.2.138 / gauge-43.

The USB-6002 intermittently delayed delivery for 10.906 seconds, then returned about 5,450 buffered samples. Native samples remained continuous, but measurement freshness failed. A bounded-read alternative reproduced the real pause and was rejected.

Supported USB input tasks now receive an atomic all-channel 1,024-byte transfer request before every initial, retry and recovery start. Unsupported optional properties retain driver defaults. The applied request size appears in startup status and reference metadata. Sampling rates, native NI time/cursor, every channel, calibration, averaging, controller settings and safety gates are unchanged.

Device D wrist/syringe qualification completed four actual Smart Const presets: Arduino 24,331/24,331 = 100%, native NI 270,320 samples, zero gaps/backtracks and maximum delivery delay 68 ms. Three-minute idle checks at three-channel 100 Hz, two-channel 100 Hz and three-channel 250 Hz delivered 9,149/9,149, 9,153/9,153 and 9,149/9,149 Arduino frames (100% each); NI samples were 18,700, 18,710 and 46,780, with maximum delays 70/70/51 ms. All final safety, state/profile preservation and simulator restoration checks passed.

Final-source GUI recovery retained the expected aborted Regular attempt, then completed its Regular retry, Smart Const and Wrist CVP. An injected stale-acquisition gate with healthy NI data caused a real task stop/reopen and product retry; the post-run vented idle lasted 180 seconds. Arduino delivery was 27,245/27,245 = 100%, native NI 294,850 samples with zero within-file gaps/backtracks. The explicit 0.041123-second restart boundary remains recorded. MAP calculation took 1,632 ms with a maximum received-frame gap of 110 ms. This qualifies the exercised recovery scenario; prolonged physical driver faults, second-PC and fleet operation remain unqualified.

The Default uploader's companion GUI target was stale at 312 while firmware was 313. Its host-side target now matches 313. C++/firmware payload remains unchanged. All 33 uploader anchors and the separate compile passed. Repository rules required a protected force-flash: complete Device D snapshot, upload, SYSTEM_READY, restore and readback preserved CAL, valve limits, feedforward and both PID profiles.

Required ten-minute seed213 soak: 6/6 completed; **Arduino 26,309/26,309 = 100%**, native NI 312,930 samples, zero gaps/backtracks. Final independent vented IDLE/pump OFF, unchanged calibration/tuning and simulator restoration passed. Pulses were OFF for this matched soak; completion does not establish controller performance.

Default 191 and Valinor 189 focused tests, seven standard/helper/parser/worker/analyzer/layout/smoke scripts per branch and nine real Git calibration-isolation tests per branch passed. Delivery/help/version checks: Default 104 passed/one skipped; Valinor 82 passed. Valinor's isolated alignment test now supplies its existing snapshot hook; production interlock behavior is unchanged.

Quiet MAP+5 remains inaccurate (latest pulse-ON errors -5.243/+3.978 mmHg). Load-sensitive inflation must retain full pump authority for very-large cuffs toward ten seconds; wrist startup, deflation startup, physical 15-35 mmHg pulse preservation, all-band SysID repeatability, fresh medium/very-large cuff comparisons, physical knob parity and second-PC/fleet qualification remain open. No fitted offset, seal diagnosis, tuning or calibration was accepted.

Evidence: D:/sc_scratch/smartcuff_continue_20261013/ni_transport_candidate and ni_transport_gui_recovery_20261013_090721. Failed attempts and original raw data remain retained. Live device snapshots are LOCAL ONLY, ignored and excluded from staging. Coordinated application builds/publication use explicit -AllowUnsigned; downloaded bytes, SHA-256, feeds and guarded installation/relaunch receive separate delivery receipts.
